description: Analyse Fernwärmeversorgung Graz is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by umweltbundesamt.at. Currently, 70 percent of the district heating is provided to the metropolitan area of Graz at the Mellach site. As of 2020, the City of Graz plans to reorganise the district heating supply as part of the “Heat 2020/2030” project. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Analysis of district heating in Graz" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include OpenDocument, Fernwärme, Luftgüte. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
